title: Bundle size and tree shaking
summary: Choose basic routing or the full data flow. Measure the exports your application actually uses.

sections.title: Routing only
sections.body: Use createRouter with named imports from @kasperrt/smolter/preact for navigation only. Its data engine is absent from the bundle. Use createDataRouter for loaders/actions, fetchers and revalidation. React offers both factories through /react.

sections.title: Measured tiers
sections.body: Sizes below are generated from the current build. Routing-only uses createRouter; common routing/data uses createDataRouter. Complete entries retain both factories and every other export. The comparable wouter subset retains Router, Route, Switch, Link, useParams and useLocation. Framework runtimes are excluded. Shared code makes rows non-additive.

sections.title: Full applications
sections.body: Full applications use createDataRouter. The SSR and file-router client helpers already select it. SSR applications additionally use /preact/client and /preact/document; lazy file routes use /preact/lazy-route. Server rendering and the Vite plugin stay in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Comparison exports and versions
sections.body: Measured against wouter and wouter-preact 3.13.0, and react-router 8.4.0. React Router has no dedicated Preact export: its React API is measured here, not a Preact compatibility build. These APIs differ in capabilities; sizes are not claims of feature equivalence. All measurements use the same production minification and gzip settings.

sections.title: Reproduce
sections.body: pnpm size builds the package and measures production ESM with esbuild, Terser and gzip level 9. Runtime library dependencies are included; React, React DOM and Preact are external. Your own bundler and selected exports can produce different results.
